params.name: picRefs
params.description: Reference numbers of the Picture Library graphics.

params.name: picNames
params.description: Names of the Picture Library graphics, synchronized with picRefs.

overloads.semanticRole: warning This command cannot be used in projects because the Picture library is only available in binary databases.

constraints: Cannot be used in projects because the Picture Library is only available in binary (.4DB) databases.
picRefs and picNames are synchronized: the nth element of picRefs is the reference number of the Picture Library graphic whose name is the nth element of picNames.
Both arrays are automatically created/resized by the command, and are returned empty if the Picture Library contains no pictures.
Maximum length of a Picture Library graphic name is 255 characters.
